description: This file contains utility methods for testing ZooKeeper connectivity, including ensuring ZooKeeper is running and handling connection checks asynchronously.

classes.name: ZookeeperTestUtils
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to verify ZooKeeper service availability for testing purposes.

classes.name: ZooKeeperWatcher
classes.description: A private nested class implementing the Watcher interface to handle ZooKeeper events.

methods.name: EnsureZooKeeper
methods.description: Checks if ZooKeeper is running; throws SkipException if not.

methods.name: EnsureZooKeeperAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously verifies the ability to connect to ZooKeeper by checking the existence of a test node.
